issues.issue: Printed Chapter CIV / editorial CV starts below the original PDF561/printed527 divider and ends above the distinct printed Chapter CV on original PDF565/printed531.
All claims about life prorogation, death-causing planets and assigned years are historical astrology, NOT clinically validated survival or mortality predictions.
Source shows no independently authenticated person, birth record, death date, blinded clinical outcome or denominator for the author's observations.
The words Hylech, Hyleg, Apheta and Prorogator are period technical terms, not modern clinical entities or ephemeris objects.
Eligible houses are 1,10,11,7,9 'or within their orbs', but the chapter does not supply full house-orb width values.
Underground rejection has an explicit exception within 25 degrees of the ascending point; preserve this numerical threshold.
Sun and Moon in houses 8 and 12 are disqualified in one branch; alternative candidates may still be invoked in different subrules.
Historical day/night Hyleg candidate selection includes sect preference, spatial ranking, syzygy, dignity and an Ascendant fallback; no one unconditional selection is justified.
Diurnal selection may use an earlier new-Moon degree despite an intervening full Moon, complicating any generic last-syzygy rule.
Nocturnal selection involves Moon at birth, preceding full-Moon/opposition point, and natal Part of Fortune; multiple candidates increase flexibility.
The dignity winner requires at least three essential fortitudes, but full dignity-weight table and available tie-break scores require independent source parity.
Even after a dignity winner is selected, eligibility in an Aphetical house is a separate required condition.
Other astrologers simply used the Ascendant; Lilly mentions them without accepting a universal agreed answer.
The source's nocturnal and diurnal examples allow the seemingly non-sect luminary to outrank the sect luminary based on house and dignities.
Proximity to Ascendant and 'most virtue' rely on source house degrees and historical dignity and aspect data, not independently recalculated astronomy.
Selecting a favorable dispositor aspect as a secondary tie-break adds chart search flexibility.
Original PDF562 includes a handwritten later marginal note; do not promote later manuscript annotation into Lilly's 1647 printed authorial text.
Lilly says he is not satisfied how to select Hyleg correctly or identify the interficient/killing planet, a load-bearing negative assessment.
The cited eighth-house Anareta location extends 5 degrees before the cusp and 25 degrees after; it is a historical inclusion window, not observed mortal risk.
He lists multiple distinct Anareta candidates: eighth-house occupant, eighth ruler, conjunction with eighth ruler, dispositor(s); Lilly explicitly rejects the conjunction-only candidate.
Marginal printed Montulmo note disputes the lethal reading of some sextiles; source witnesses disagree about which aspects are dangerous.
Claims that directions to cusps, eclipses, comets, nebulous sectors, azimene degrees or Mercury aspects bring death are unverified traditional associations.

Alcochodon as giver of greater/lesser years is defined by dignity and aspect to Hyleg; its historical lifetime-year tables are cross-referenced to other first-edition pages and not independently validated against survival data.
Source allows fatal directions, sudden accidents, regional calamities and individual luck to override allotments of years; this creates exception flexibility.
Some luminaries can be both Hyleg and Alcochodon when in house or exaltation, while sign-ruler alternative applies otherwise.
Equal-strength Alcochodon candidates use aspect to Hyleg, then essential dignity, oriental/daytime and angular position rules; each can alter result.

Lilly explicitly expresses dissatisfaction with Hyleg, Anareta and Alcochodon and proposes a further retrospective review of deceased people's charts, without providing independent verified data in this chapter.
Following printed Chapter CV Lord of the Geniture starts below divider original PDF565 and continues PDF566; that chapter's rules are excluded except for navigational context.
The original six original-page images PDF561-566 are SHA256 and byte frozen, but no complete independent diplomatic secondary transcription or period astronomical parity is claimed.
Zero independent death/clinical prediction validations or runtime model promotions result from documentary source extraction.
